spriteAtlas:
Create a production pixel-art sprite atlas for HoloCrawl, a Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup style 32x32-tile roguelike. A single atlas image with EXACTLY 8 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, 32 cells total. Entire background transparent alpha. Each cell contains ONE centered compact distinct game sprite, no frame, no text, no numbers, no labels. Art should be hard-edged retro pixel art on a 32x32 logical pixel grid per cell, displayed enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Dark 1-pixel outlines, restrained 5-8 color ramps, overhead/front three-quarter dungeon game readability. Keep silhouettes inside the middle 26x26 logical pixels and at least 3 pixels transparent margin. Icons are deity emblems, NOT character portraits.
Row 1 left to right: (1) blue comet and silver star (Suisei); (2) red-and-white sacred shrine bell with pink sakura (Miko); (3) pink rose and green vine (Aki); (4) white fox head with cyan ghost flame (Fubuki); (5) crossed scarlet twin katana with a small oni horn (Ayame); (6) purple heart with a tiny red medical cross (Choco); (7) orange paw-print with brass knuckles (Korone); (8) violet sleeping cat curled on a riceball (Okayu).

effectAtlas:
Production animation sprite atlas for a 32x32-tile pixel-art dungeon roguelike. EXACT 8 columns and 4 rows, all 32 square cells equal, transparent alpha background, no gutters or borders, no text, no checkerboard. Each sprite is an effect for a single tile viewed overhead. Strict hard-edged pixel art, 32x32 logical pixels per sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor. One-pixel dark edges, limited palette. Keep each sprite within 28x28 pixels with at least 2 pixels transparent padding. Every effect MUST have mostly EMPTY TRANSPARENT CENTER so dungeon floor and enemies remain readable: only corner brackets, thin outlines, a few particles. Each adjacent pair is two frames of the SAME effect with small coherent changes in sparks/ripples. Pairs must match color and silhouette.
Row1: cells1-2 amber square corner brackets with a tiny triangle danger sign near upper edge (warning); cells3-4 bright red square corner brackets plus tiny X spark (imminent hostile danger); cells5-6 pink and ivory sacred floor sigil with four petal corners (sanctuary); cells7-8 emerald vine-root outline with rose petals at corners (garden).
Row2: cells1-2 turquoise puddle OUTLINE with ripples only around edges (water field); cells3-4 violet gravity vortex ring, transparent hole occupying at least central 18x18 logical pixels (gravity field); cells5-6 pale cyan orbital ellipse ring, hollow center (orbit); cells7-8 orange ember corners and small flame tips around edges, hollow center (fire aura).
Row3: cells1-2 jade-gold fan-pattern corners, hollow center (art exhibition); cells3-4 magenta-gold spotlight diamond border with only a few glints, hollow center (spotlight); cells5-6 ice-blue frost crystal corners, hollow center (frost); cells7-8 lilac electric zigzag corners and small rhythm pulses, hollow center (rhythm).
Row4: cells1-2 silver-cyan shield-rune border with hollow center (protective shield); cells3-4 lime-green bubbly slime edge, hollow center (slime); cells5-6 orange-gold explosion sparks in four corners with a very small central white spark (impact animation); cells7-8 blue-white comet trail diagonal with small star at lower right and mostly transparent negative space (comet animation).
Professional game-ready hard pixel clusters. Shapes must remain distinct at native 32px. Exact 8x4 cells, same dimensions. Do not use full colored squares, solid discs, smooth airbrushing, scenery, objects, typography or cast shadows.
